title: Plastics.
officialText:
Plastic panel, apron or spandrel walls as defined in this code shall not be limited in thickness, provided that such
plastics and their assemblies conform to the requirements of Chapter 26 and are constructed of approved weather-resistant materials
of adequate strength to resist the wind loads for cladding specified in Chapter 16.
